days.title: Northern Peaks and Gardens
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Glanleam House
stops.detail: In the northeast of the island is "Glanleam House" (Teach Ghleann Laoim), whose garden features subtropical plants.

stops.name: Menhir von Glanleam
stops.detail: The Glanleam Menhir (Standing Stone) stands in the center of a fort, near Cromwell Point and its lighthouse at one of the northern tips of Valentia Island.

stops.name: Geokaun
stops.detail: The Geokaun (Irish: an Geocán) is the highest mountain on Valentia Island.

stops.name: Knightstown
stops.detail: In addition, there is a ferry connection from Reenard Point to Knightstown, the most important settlement on the island, between April and September.

stops.name: Mariengrotte
stops.detail: Another attraction on the island is the Mariengrotte (Mary's Grotto) in a former quarry.

stops.name: Wedge Tomb von Cool East
stops.detail: The Wedge Tomb of Cool East is also located on the island.
